style: Original dark fantasy necromancy: worn charcoal cloth, bone ivory, oxidized bronze, restrained spectral jade. Readable silhouettes for a top-down horde game.
retry_policy: No paid regeneration, remesh, conversion, or additional animation outside the approved cap without approval.

assets.prompt: Original stylized dark fantasy necromancer adventurer, full body humanoid in neutral T-pose, clearly separated arms and legs, empty open hands, no held props, no base. Broad readable silhouette for top-down game. Deep hood with visible pale masked face, compact bone shoulder armor, fitted charcoal tunic with split knee-length coat panels, leather trousers and tall boots. Small jade talisman on chest. Practical proportions, solid clean geometry, no loose chains or floating parts, no floor-length robe or cape. Detailed but restrained, game-ready low-poly style.
assets.texture_prompt: Painterly dark fantasy game character. Weathered charcoal and muted teal cloth, aged ivory bone shoulder plates, oxidized bronze clasps, brown leather boots, pale mask and subtle jade chest talisman. Strong readable material separation, restrained highlights, no lettering, no heavy baked directional shadows.

assets.prompt: Original stylized dark fantasy gravebound revenant, full body solid humanoid in neutral T-pose, arms and legs clearly separated, empty hands, no weapon, no base.
